description: Build a compact wallet snapshot from SOL balance, SPL and Token-2022 holdings, and recent activity. Returns one current snapshot, not an investment recommendation. Example: {"wallet":"Brpc8HoPo1d3Uiyo7kbERnjMqwLJJmbWxtwxHxzar6DU","network":"mainnet-beta"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

wallet.description: Wallet or program address in Base58 format (32–44 characters).

name: get_wallet_snapshot
